status: Experimental comparison, not replacement of v0.13
memory_tasks: Four fields with eight inventory values (4096 possible complete keys). Teacher labels are deterministic pseudo-random four-class assignments. All methods share identical taught keys. Untaught complete keys are expected to abstain, regardless of their latent label. This is memory recovery, not rule generalization or an expansion of the v0.13 hypothesis family.
positive: H_y=sum_{i:y_i=y} w_i b_i. Minimize squared scores on all observed teacher keys plus ridge toward w=1, projected to [.25,2]. No unobserved-key targets.
residual: H_y=sum_all_observed_i B_iy b_i. Signed and cross-class correction coefficients minimize ||G B-T||^2 + ridge ||B-T||^2. More expressive than positive weighting; ordinary linear solve in training, not pure SS control.
gain_control: Double all uniform coefficients; raw threshold .5 and renormalized clean output examined separately. Not a candidate to adopt.
threshold_policy: Known responses anchored to one, other taught labels to zero. Threshold fixed at .5 before evaluation for every method. No threshold tuning or separate calibration labels in this experiment.
degradation: erasure75: a deterministic common coordinate mask leaves D/4 entries; correlation divided by observed count. quant4: round real/imag weights separately to 15 symmetric values using one per-model peak scale; simulated only, arrays remain complex128. weight_noise: same additive complex noise across methods, real/imag sd=.25/sqrt(2), no per-model normalization.
exact: Same teachers in exact table. Identity-kernel positive/residual optima equal the original one-hot table; validate this numerically in unit tests. Exact used for clean logical comparison, not assigned an artificial SS-style erasure or quantization channel.
structured_regression: Original16 v0.13 tasks, initial and fixed one-teacher prefix selected by the original uniform model. Four methods uniform/positive/residual/exact, D128/512/2048 with two original code seeds for SS; exact once per task. Candidate masks, partial-input acceptance rule, vocabulary and threshold unchanged. All receive same extra teacher. This is controlled replay, not newly integrated weighted online Session.
evaluation: Freeze code, tests, protocol and data before final runs. Repeat final results and saved models. Report correct/wrong/abstain, unknown false acceptance, scores, matched teacher and storage costs, training time, signal energy and coefficient range. No superiority is required to pass verification. No post-test tuning. No R1, language, P1/S1 integration or external teacher.
